name: @omni-studio/monorepo
description: OmniStudio — 本地大模型一体化桌面工作台 | A desktop workstation for local LLMs: models, servers, and apps (chat, voice, image, OCR).

scripts.push:canary: bun pm version prerelease --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:patch: bun pm version prepatch --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:minor: bun pm version preminor --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:major: bun pm version premajor --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:stable: bun pm version patch && git push origin main --tags
